name: visual-companion
description: Browser-based visual question I/O bridge for Ouroboros workflows.

commands.name: start
commands.summary: Start a local visual companion browser server and return session connection info.

arguments.name: project_dir
arguments.description: Project directory where .brainstorm session files should persist.

commands.name: show
commands.summary: Publish an agent-authored HTML screen into an active visual companion session.

arguments.name: html
arguments.description: HTML fragment or document to show in the browser.

commands.name: wait
commands.summary: Wait for the next browser click or form event and return it as JSON.

arguments.name: timeout_ms
arguments.description: Maximum time to wait for a browser event.

commands.name: read
commands.summary: Recover the latest pending durable browser event without blocking.

commands.name: stop
commands.summary: Stop a visual companion session and record the lifecycle result.

arguments.name: session_dir
arguments.description: Session directory containing content and state directories.

capabilities.name: ledger
capabilities.reason: Record visual question lifecycle, event results, and blocked states.

capabilities.name: state
capabilities.reason: Persist visual companion session metadata and event recovery state.

capabilities.name: provenance
capabilities.reason: Record bundled skill source, copied assets, command arguments, and generated artifacts.

capabilities.name: runtime
capabilities.reason: Start and stop the bundled local Node browser server.

capabilities.name: handoff
capabilities.reason: Attach browser URL, screen files, events, diagnostics, and session results to downstream workflows.

capabilities.name: progress
capabilities.reason: Report session lifecycle and wait/read progress.

permissions.reason: Read bundled scripts, input HTML, and existing visual companion session state.
Write screen files, session metadata, event state, diagnostics, and handoff artifacts.
Execute the bundled Node scripts that serve screens and wait for browser events.
